hooks.command: cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/reference/LAWS.md" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/reference/LESSONS.md"; echo; echo "NOTES: the lead reads reference/STATUS.md now. Every helper reads its own reference/notes/<your-name>.md now (create it in your first commit if it is missing; rules: reference/notes/README.md) and keeps it current at every report."; echo; echo "LEAD: before any other work, read the latest day review and apply its fixes today:"; ls -1 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/reference/daily/"*.md 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | xargs -r cat
